stages.title: Preflight + schema/migration/recurrence foundation
stages.objective: Verify the frozen v0.1 baseline and implement only the Prisma finance/reminder schema foundation, migration/backfill safety, recurrence primitives, durable delivery/idempotency primitives, and their deterministic tests. Do not begin major UI work in this stage.
evidence: baseline analysis-contract, typecheck and build status recorded
schema/migration delta documented and tested against non-production data
legacy meal reminders preserved
Decimal money and transfer semantics established
recurrence and idempotency tests pass
git diff --check passes and a meaningful checkpoint is pushed

stages.title: Life Hub shell + Today
stages.objective: Implement the shared module registry, desktop/mobile navigation, /today read model and Quick Add shell while preserving existing /dashboard Food and /hydration Water behavior and auth redirects.
evidence: Today route and navigation tests pass
Food and Water route regressions pass
auth/deep-link behavior remains correct
desktop/mobile primary navigation has no blocking overflow
meaningful checkpoint is pushed

stages.title: Finance core
stages.objective: Implement manual-first financial accounts and INCOME/EXPENSE/TRANSFER transactions, authoritative monthly totals/category summaries, ownership validation, and Finance UI/actions without adding obligations/reminders yet.
evidence: BANK/CASH/WALLET/CREDIT_CARD account tests pass
income/expense/transfer accounting tests pass
transfers do not change income/expense totals
cross-user and forged-ID negative tests pass
meaningful checkpoint is pushed

stages.title: Obligations + generic reminder engine
stages.objective: Implement bills/subscriptions/recharge/other obligation CRUD, recurrence/next-due behavior, generic HEALTH/FINANCE reminder data and offsets, durable scheduler claim/dedupe, snooze, and compatibility with existing meal reminders. Do not add final Telegram finance callbacks yet.
evidence: obligation CRUD and recurrence cases pass including 28/56/84-day recharge
monthly end-of-month and leap-year behavior is deterministic
multiple reminder offsets and durable delivery dedupe pass
process restart/same-minute duplicate tests pass
legacy meal reminder regression passes
meaningful checkpoint is pushed

review.label: Review B
criteria: Finance and Reminder domain boundaries are coherent
finance reminders are not fake meal categories
scheduler uses one durable idempotent delivery path
snooze does not move recurrence anchors
ownership and stale/disabled obligation behavior are safe

stages.title: Paid/Done/Snooze + Telegram integration
stages.objective: Implement Paid/Done/Open/Snooze behavior, exactly-once optional expense creation, recurrence advancement, finance Telegram reminder formatting/callbacks and ownership validation while preserving existing meal/hydration Telegram behavior under safe mock/test configuration.
evidence: Paid with and without expense creation is idempotent
double web/Telegram callbacks cannot duplicate expenses
recurring and ONCE completion behavior passes
stale/cross-user callbacks are rejected safely
existing hydration/meal Telegram regression coverage passes
meaningful checkpoint is pushed

stages.title: Final integration + security/runtime hardening
stages.objective: Complete Today aggregation, empty/loading/partial-error states, responsive behavior, security/privacy negatives, isolated Omarchy runtime/Docker verification, the complete v0.1 test matrix, secret scan and branch hygiene. Do not open/merge the final PR until Review C PASS.
evidence: complete applicable TEST_MATRIX.md gates executed with exact counts
Food and Water regression passes
Today/Finance/Reminders integrated acceptance scenario passes
Omarchy isolated runtime/Docker smoke evidence recorded
secret scan and git diff --check pass
task branch is clean and pushed at a meaningful checkpoint

review.label: Review C
criteria: full v0.1 scope matches frozen specifications
all required tests/gates are evidenced without production claims
security/privacy and ownership controls are sufficient
provider interruption history, if any, did not create false FAIL/duplicate work
branch is suitable for final PR creation

stages.title: PR finalization after Review C PASS
stages.objective: After Review C PASS only, perform final branch/remote cleanliness checks, push the final task branch state, open the pull request against main, and record PR/test/review evidence. Do not merge and do not deploy/migrate production.
evidence: Review C PASS is present before PR finalization
final branch SHA and local==origin/clean state recorded
PR references GitHub Issue #129 and Paperclip stage/review evidence
PR remains unmerged for owner review
